mismatch.right: An ogre lord walks up while four weak monsters fight the warrior: leave, or at least don't engage it.

priority.right: Three zombies close by and an orcish mage casting from range: kill the mage first.

loot.right: A corpse holds valuables and junk while an orc walks up: take the valuables, skip the junk, stop looting when the orc arrives.

attrition.right: A long fight on six bandages and one heal potion: disengage before the supplies are gone, unless the last monster is nearly dead.

swarm.right: Six melee monsters on a mage: survive and kill at least four.

pack-gargoyles.right: Two orcs fight a warrior; three gargoyles (a fair fight each, and spellcasters) come at it from 14 tiles: get away before they are on it, and survive.

archer-kite.right: Four orcs come at an archer from 10 tiles: shoot them as they come, step back when two reach it, and kill all four without dying.

tamer-orcs.right: Three orcs come at a tamer with a grizzly bear: set the bear on them, bandage it between hits, and call it back if it is losing; kill all three without losing the bear.

tamer-ogre-lord.right: An ogre lord walks up to a tamer with a grizzly bear, two orcs with it. Neither can beat it, and it runs as fast as the tamer: leave early, and if it catches up, let the bear hold it off. The tamer must survive; losing the bear is reported.

bard-provoke.right: An ogre and two orcs come at a bard: set them on each other and calm whatever reaches the bard; survive while at least two of them die.

warrior-mage-opener.right: Two orcs come at a warrior-mage from 8 tiles: open on one with a spell while it comes, fight in melee, and have the sword back in hand after every cast; kill both.

mage-tamer-orcs.right: Three orcs come at a mage-tamer with a grizzly bear: set the bear on them, cast at what it fights, heal it with spells; kill all three without losing the bear.

necro-orcs.right: Three orcs come at a necromancer from 8 tiles: kill them with necromancy without dying.

paladin-orcs.right: Four orcs come at a paladin: fight them in melee with its blessings (at least one cast) and kill all four without dying.
